If the partial pressure of H2 decreases by x atm as the reaction proceeds, then the par- tial pressure of I2 must also decrease by x atm because each mole of H2 reacts with 1 mol of I2. By similar reasoning, the partial pressure of HI increases by 2x atm: 2 mol of HI forms from each mole of H2.
